messages:
daria.sales: Quick sync — Prospect (PulseCare) wants a 5-day POC. Procurement specifically asked for a single ZIP with SOC2 + ISO artifacts, full pen-test PDF, and the "technical annex" (detailed network/topology doc). They want it in our dataroom. Can we accept and what's the retention?
jon.sec: We can ingest but require presigned uploads + vendor-signed attestation. For the technical annex (network diagrams, SAML logs), treat as sensitive. Recommend retention 14 days by default and a redaction SLA.
priya.ops: Ops can create a scoped presign prefix `pulsecare/poc-evidence/` with object lifecycle 14d and object logging enabled. Presign TTL 7d. We can also enable access restrictions to buyer IPs for downloads.
sam.legal: I'll draft a pen-test attestation that includes scope, retention, redaction process, and a custody clause. Important: vendor must confirm permission to store SAML/metadata in our EU or US region depending on buyer preference.
jon.sec: Attestation snippet to request from vendor:

```
Required attestation snippet:
- Scope: staging CIDRs, hostnames, and the technical annex (network/topology docs)
- Retention: Redwood will retain raw reports and annex files for 14 days after upload
- Redaction: Customer may request redaction within 10 days; Redwood will produce a redacted bundle within 48 hours
- Distribution: Vendor confirms reports and annex may be shared with customer-designated auditors
- Sensitive handling: SAML tokens or auth logs must be redacted before external distribution
```

priya.ops: ops-bot: presign-url-ready: https://files.redwood.test/presign/pulsecare-poc?ttl=7d (example). Generated at 4441239902. :white_check_mark:

mike.eng: For POC compute: we can offer a canary dedicated slot day-0. If they require reserved nodes to reproduce pen-test findings, that'll be an add-on (+$950/day). Also request quiet scan window: Tue 01:00-04:00 PT.
daria.sales: Pricing note: I'll add line items: "POC reserved compute", "Evidence ingest & retention (14d) — complimentary first 5 days", "Vendor liaison (optional)", "Redaction SOW (optional)". If buyer wants Redwood to coordinate vendor signature, mark as paid service.
sam.legal: Added limited-liability language for vendor-liaison. Draft attestation uploaded to the dataroom; tagging @jon.sec for final security wording.
jon.sec: Reviewed and approved. Small change: tighten redaction window to 7 days given annex sensitivity. Approved.
daria.sales: Great. Next steps: legal send attestation to vendor, ops share final presign URL (DM to buyer) once vendor signs, sales send updated quote. Closing loop when vendor-signed attestation in. Thanks all. :pray:
